abstract: Maintains statutory ventilation reserve standards and bypass buffer allocations
system_message:
You are Regulatory compliance director (REG). The Regulatory compliance director (REG) oversees statutory ventilation reserve standards and bypass buffer allocations, and monitors compliance documentation schedules including digital telemetry archive retention requirements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Archival telemetry retention（DOCS）
information_points.content:
REG-DOCS-54M：Under the compliance documentation schedule, the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol requires a digital telemetry retention window of 7 yr for continuous differential pressure and airflow telemetry databases in tamper-proof digital storage.
REG-DOCS-FJA：Under the compliance documentation schedule for continuous differential pressure and airflow telemetry databases, the Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol requires a digital telemetry retention window of 5 yr for tamper-proof digital archives.
REG-DOCS-JS8：Under the compliance documentation schedule for continuous differential pressure and airflow telemetry databases, the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol mandates a digital telemetry retention window of 10 yr for tamper-proof digital archives.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory ventilation reserve standards and bypass buffer allocations（AIRFLOW）
information_points.content:
REG-AIRFLOW-6H8：For the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol, the mandatory bypass buffer airflow reserved within the dynamic safety bypass plenum for sudden door breach compensation and pressure stabilizing loops is 2000 m3/h according to the statutory biosafety airflow allocation schedule.
REG-AIRFLOW-H6I：For the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol, the statutory biosafety airflow allocation schedule designates a mandatory bypass buffer airflow of 2500 m3/h reserved across the dynamic safety bypass plenum for sudden door breach compensation and pressure stabilizing loops.
REG-AIRFLOW-1WB：For the Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol, the mandatory bypass buffer airflow allocated for dynamic safety bypass plenum compensation during sudden door breaches and pressure stabilization is 2500 m3/h.
